name: typst-document-generator
description: Opinionated Typst document templates as agent skills: personal, public, business, client-confidential, personal-confidential, briefing and a spec-format screenplay. The plugin is generic; your identity, business, logo and your own formats live in a private overlay folder (~/.claude-user-data/typst-document-generator or $TYPST_DOCGEN_HOME) that overrides and extends the built-ins without forking.
